pitchei-teshuva.1#_: They will not feed him. See responsa Chaim Shaal part 2 who wrote in the name of Derech HaMelech: one who has chametz that passed Pesach and others come to eat from it — since for them no penalty applies he need not tell them not to eat; one sage disagrees; the author agreed one must inform them; see there.
pitchei-teshuva.2#_: And in another city. Pri Toar wrote only when he has no benefit from saying he is Jewish, etc.; see Noda BiYehudah second part Even HaEzer beginning siman 80 who wrote his words are not compelling and even per his view this is only to rely leniently that his wine contact is permitted, but to be stringent, etc.; see there.
pitchei-teshuva.3#_: The money. Baer Heitev; see responsa Bashamayim Rosh siman 97 and Hagahot Kasav there; see Mishnat Chachamim Laws of Idolatry daf 103 in Tzafnat Paaneach letter 168: if he fed his fellow's forbidden item his law is like one who steals and feeds — sometimes collects from the feeder and sometimes from the eater; if the victim collects from the eater it seems the eater cannot return to the feeder saying he fed forbidden and it is not considered eating therefore the feeder pays; the law of feeding others is not like a seller — requires study, end of his words.
pitchei-teshuva.4#_: His actions prove. See responsa Beit Efrayim Yoreh Deah siman 1 regarding a slaughterer about whom rumor spread — clearly our speech is not removing the slaughterer from his presumption even for an incessant rumor, for any rumor not established in court is nothing; all the more here the rumor is a woman's gossip, etc.; also wrote it appears even a scrupulous person need not be concerned though we say this language is bad, etc. — only where there is no excuse to attribute the rumor as false and perhaps true; but where there is an excuse that out of spite unnamed people spread slander — no concern for that rumor at all; see there.
pitchei-teshuva.5#_: I was inadvertent. Shach; see responsa Pri Tevuah 12 and 14; see what is written above siman 1 s.k. 4 in the name of Ateret Zahav in Peri Megadim see there.
pitchei-teshuva.6#_: And that which he must, etc. See responsa Beit Efrayim Yoreh Deah part siman 5 what he wrote on this.
